text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......Kh.
I have no choice but to admit it... huh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "I... I am under the curse of Medusa right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What's the cause...?
Is it the dry climate?
Or could it be my overeating from the other day...?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Either way... we must receive the blessings
from the Spring of Juturna as soon as possible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Tanino Gimlet is troubled by rough skin...
